scope: Source patch fixing the Vulkan wrapper host-CPU BCn sRGB decode convention, built from the pinned source and qualified with a 4 KB emulator A/B against the compute-shader and native paths. Experimental component work only; no app asset, default, driver install or packaging change.

patch.applies_to: 3abf4870 with patch -p1 --fuzz=0 (forward and reverse dry-run verified on a pristine archive extraction)

defect_and_fix.defect: BC*_SRGB host-CPU (bcdec) decode stored sRGB-encoded texel values, while the compute-shader decoders store linear values. The emulated image format for a BC*_SRGB source is R8G8B8A8_UNORM (no hardware sRGB decode on sampling; the wrapper also patches image views to UNORM), so stored texels must be linear to reproduce the original sampled colours. Two paths therefore disagreed by up to 74 LSB.
defect_and_fix.fix: After the bcdec decode in the host path, linearise the RGB channels of each 4x4 block with the IEC 61966-2-1 transfer function, using double precision with ties-to-even rounding to mirror the compute shader float->UNORM conversion; alpha is left unchanged. The patch also records the format mapping rationale in comments.
rationale_evidence: wrapper source: unwrap_vk_format_physical_device maps BC*_SRGB to R8G8B8A8_UNORM and views are patched to that format, so sampling performs no sRGB decode
compute shaders (s3tc.comp/bc7.comp) already apply srgb_to_linear for SRGB originals
reference probe computes the linearised decode as the correct sRGB reference

runtime_ab.adjudication: The correct convention is the linear one (compute-shader and emulated-UNORM sampling semantics). The patch brings the host-CPU path into agreement with it to within 1 LSB rounding, and leaves every other path byte-identical. The reference tool currently encodes the old convention as the host-cpu sRGB expectation; updating that expectation (or adding a host-convention flag) is a follow-up tool change so future patched runs report PASS rather than a stale-convention failure. No app behaviour is affected by this experimental component patch.
